propositions: serverInfo HTTP 200 is insufficient to declare live-DC ready because custom fields like Epic Link and Epic Name may not be registered yet, causing readiness to pass while fields are unavailable

the harness readiness gate polls only /rest/api/2/serverInfo and never verifies the _REQUIRED_FIELDS contract, creating a latent timing flake that misattributes field absence to image degrade rather than plugin initialization delay
the probe and harness workflows use divergent readiness definitions after 1387, with the probe checking field inventory but the harness still using serverInfo only, allowing their behavior to drift
a system-only field inventory (zero customfield_* entries) following serverInfo 200 must be treated as NOT-READY, not as a successful state, to prevent flakes from being misdiagnosed
both live-DC integration paths must share one canonical readiness definition including bounded field-inventory polling to prevent divergence and ensure consistent failure diagnostics
